mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_job (checkpoint_date, corporate_number) SELECT checkpoint_date, corporate_number FROM company_entry WHERE checkpoint_date = #{checkpointDate} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS (SELECT corporate_number FROM export_job WHERE checkpoint_date = #{checkpointDate} AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'processing' AND claimed_at < now() - (#{leaseSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval) OR status = 'failed' ) LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE export_job SET status = 'processing', claimed_by = #{instanceId}, claimed_at = now(), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 FROM claimed WHERE export_job.corporate_number = claimed.corporate_number AND export_job.checkpoint_date = #{checkpointDate} RETURNING export_job.corporate_number
